def VTask.strongDownwardInduction {α : Type u_1} {p : Multiset α → Sort u_3} {n : ℕ}
  (H : (t₁ : Multiset α) → ({t₂ : Multiset α} → t₂.card ≤ n → t₁ < t₂ → p t₂) → t₁.card ≤ n → p t₁)
  (s : Multiset α) (hs : s.card ≤ n) : p s :=
match hs with
| nat.zero =>
  let h : ∀ t₂ : Multiset α, t₂.card ≤ 0 → t₁ < t₂ → p t₂ := fun _ _ _ => absurd hz (ne_of_gt hz)
  H ∅ h 0
| nat.succ m =>
  let rec go (k : ℕ) (sk : k ≤ m) (t₁ : Multiset α) (ht₁ : t₁.card = k) :
    (∀ t₂ : Multiset α, t₂.card ≤ m → t₁ < t₂ → p t₂) → p t₁ :=
  match k with
  | nat.zero =>
    let h : ∀ t₂ : Multiset α, t₂.card ≤ m → t₁ < t₂ → p t₂ := fun _ _ _ => absurd hz (ne_of_gt hz)
    H t₁ h sk
  | nat.succ l =>
    let hl : l ≤ m := le_trans sk hl
    let rec aux (t₂ : Multiset α) (ht₂ : t₂.card = l) (ht₁ltt₂ : t₁ < t₂) :
      p t₂ :=
      go l hl t₂ ht₂ (λ t₃ ht₃ htt₂, aux t₃ ht₃ htt₂)
    H t₁ aux sk
  go m hm s hs (λ t₂ ht₂ htt₁, absurd ht₂ (not_le_of_lt htt₁))
